gloss: to be humid; to be stuffy; to steam

definitions.gloss: to be stuffy; to be humid and hot
definitions.explanation: When enclosed spaces or clothing become uncomfortably warm and humid.
When skin or body parts become hot and sweaty due to poor ventilation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蒸|む}れて⟦{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い→気持ち悪い：07154_kimochiwarui⟧。
examples.english: In summer, my shoes get stuffy and uncomfortable.

notes:
{蒸|む}れる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive form is ⟦{蒸|む}らす→蒸らす：16150_murasu⟧ (to steam, to let something get humid).

ASPECT (ている):
{蒸|む}れている indicates an ongoing state of being stuffy or humid.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蒸|む}れる - shoes get stuffy
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蒸|む}れる - room becomes stuffy
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蒸|む}れる - feet get sweaty
- {蒸|む}れた⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧ - humid heat

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{湿|しめ}る→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧ - to become damp (more general)
- ⟦{蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い→蒸し暑い：03751_mushiatsui⟧ - muggy, sultry (adjective)
- {蒸|む}れる specifically implies uncomfortable heat and humidity combined
